reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text:
Just a heads-up for anyone considering Plaud: there is now a very large Google Calendar integration bar at the top of the app, with no option to hide or remove it. If you don’t use Google Calendar, you may want to consider a different solution.

Unfortunately, Plaud also seems to be ignoring feedback from the community that helped make it successful. It’s disappointing to see a company move in this direction rather than listen to the users who supported it from the beginning.

reviews.title: Katastrophe seit dem Update

reviews.title: No way to change email address
reviews.text: For some unknown reason Plaud have created a system where it is impossible to change the email address that you registered originally. If you lose access to your email you lose access to all your notes.

reviews.title: Avoid the new update
reviews.text:
AutoFlow, a feature I valued greatly (as part of the unlimited subscription) is now locked behind an additional paywall. 

The App is less intuitive. It keeps crashing. 

The recordings seem less accurate with more mistakes in the transcriptions. I’m now having to move the raw transcripts to chatGPT to summarise and tidy up, which sort of defeats the point. 

Auto speaker recognition has been switched off. This was a very useful function. All the speaker profiles I had saved have been deleted. 

The personalisation instructions I worked hard to build have been mostly deleted and only a small paragraph has been retained. 

This is a very disappointing upgrade. After spending a large amount on the device and then a larger amount on the subscription. I’m disappointed. 

The Reddit forums are filled with similar experiences.

Plaud was an indispensable part of my workflow and I’ll now need to look elsewhere. 

You might want to look further afield before investing in this product.

reviews.title: Paid plan minutes run out too fast
reviews.text:
After a year of using the PLAUD Note, I can say the device itself is good, but the subscription model ruins the experience.
I bought the hardware and pay for a subscription, yet the included transcription minutes run out very quickly. After 12 months, I still have to constantly watch my remaining balance instead of just using the product I paid for.
For someone who invested in both the device and a paid plan, the allowance feels too limited and seems designed to push you toward the Unlimited plan. Support was polite, but couldn't address the core issue, which is the subscription structure.
I don't recommend it unless they fix the subscription.

I can use the web however when traveling I do not have internet access and want to work on notes with my keyboard vs trying to type on the iPhone.

reviews.text: After being a subscriber for a few months, my Plaud device stopped recording properly. Support replaced it with a device that never functioned right. I could never get FindMy working on my new device. I cancelled my nearly $250 per year subscription and they keep charging my card even after cancelling o their website, and then contacting support. They just now tried to charge my card again for a fourth time. This company seems legit until you’ve used them for a whole. Seems scammy. Be aware. (Their AI has responded to this saying that they want me to write support which I have already been doing repeatedly every single time it tries to charge my card and they have not resolved it so as an update, this is still happening and it’s been many days since I posted this. They do not have people doing any real work, shopper be aware)

reviews.title: Vorsicht
reviews.text:
Ich wollte etwas ganz simples, nämlich eine Rechnung für den Dienst. Ich habe vorher beim Support nachgefragt, ob das möglich ist, und mir wurde schriftlich bestätigt, dass es kein Problem ist.  

Ich habe dann gebucht und plötzlich konnte die Firma mir keine Rechnung zur Verfügung stellen, trotz der schriftlichen Zusage. Ich habe dreimal nachgefragt, und außer „Blabla“ kam gar nichts.  

Weiterhin finde ich es sehr verwunderlich, dass es bei Apple günstiger ist als über die Plattform selbst. Für mich ist das sehr unseriös und ich rate vom Produkt ab.  

Bei der App selbst nervt es ungemein, dass man keine Aufzeichnungen darüber starten kann. Man muss es immer über die Hardware machen. Es ist mir unbegreiflich, warum so eine einfache Funktionalität schlichtweg nicht eingebaut wird.

reviews.title: Not what you’re likely thinking
reviews.text:
This app appears to require that a separate (expensive!) hardware device be purchased and then used with your iOS/iPad device. That this is the case is not particularly obvious (no doubt intended). That said, it does look like perhaps audio transcripts recorded on an iPhone for example, can be imported into and then processed by the Plaud AI engine. Unfortunately (also not apparent until they’ve got you “hooked”, you can’t test how well that functionality works…..until after you’ve signed up. 

I for one am tired of this kind of snot-nosed tech-bro behavior. Just be fargin’ honest kids. Jesus! - a recently retired aerospace/engineering tech fellow.

reviews.title: Simply doesn’t work :(
reviews.text: Bought the pro device and started the trial today. Generation never finished (tried auto and non-auto), takes forever and results with a generic error message without any details what to do next. $20 a month is also a joke as Otter or Notability provide the same for the half of the price. The device has the display, but it is useless and just one button is confusing and not ergonomic (e.g. I want to separate meetings and using long press and other press is supper annoying and led to missing recordings). Transcription is also not the best, unfortunately. I run it in parallel with Notability and it transcribed better (less errors)

reviews.title: Poor allowance
reviews.text: What I didn’t expect with this product was the restriction of its very purpose - this isnt a cheap device yet it restricts you considerably on using it without an ongoing paid subscription. The minutes should be considerably higher

reviews.title: Not worth nearly $400
reviews.text:
Plaud AI tells me that it cannot turn things into docs, thinks a “printable format” for a list is a wall of plain text, and will not integrate with anything, it also said it could not save our text thread to one of the folders in the app or save it as a note, it said it did not know contact info for Plaud customer service or how to get a refund. It told me that it is a Google AI even though it will not integrate with any google products like I need. It told me to contact my “service provider” regarding refund requests, very confusing. It seemed to not know who/what Plaud is when it is labeled as Plaud AI. On transcription summary notes where I did a “brain dump” talking to myself to make a to do list while driving it seemed to think “Plaud” was another person I was speaking to and seemed concerned that this Plaud person didn’t know I was recording. 

I could have just gotten a cheap little voice recorder and input recordings into ChatGPT. That would be about 10% of the cost I paid Plaud and provide a better product. ChatGPT creates printable documents and ics calendar files for me for free. 

Plaud used false and misleading advertising that their system integrates with many things. It doesn’t. It is a voice recorder with transcription. That tech has been around for a long time. Audio transcription tech can be found for free. The AI summaries can be done for free with several different language learning AI. Gemini isn’t even the best one imo and that is what Plaud AI seems to

reviews.title: No integrations, no Apple Find My
reviews.text:
The app is functional, and so is the device. But is it not worth the cost for the device and then a subscription on top of it. It’s effectively a glorified audio recorder. 

The integrations are “coming soon” and Apple Find My doesn’t show up in the app, even following their support articles.

They have a free plan of 300 minutes, but if your actually planning to use the unreasonably expensive £149 device, you then have to pay a minimum of £100/year on top of that for 20h transcribing, or £225/year for unlimited transcribing.

Everything “cool” happens in the app, which I’m pretty sure I could rebuild from scratch in 48h using wisper and diarization, as well as more features like webhooks and direct integration into Notion, for much lower cost or virtually free.

reviews.title: Bonne appli et environnement Plaud  - 👎 Déçu car manque l’intégration/transfert natif Google Drive
reviews.text:
L’appli et l’environnement Plaud sont top. L’abonnement illimité n’est pas donné mais clairement indispensable.
Je ne comprends pas qu’il ne soit pas possible (à ce prix) de faire un transfert en masse des transcript/resumé/analyse vers Google Drive, de manière native et gratuite.
On est obligé de passer par une solution tiers (Zapier) qui elle est payante. Vraiment dommage, cela limite grandement l’exploitation des données.
Pour cette raison, je pense annuler mon abonnement

Keep in mind,
This is a Chinese company that is tries to tell the story of a US registered company (which anyone can do) with Singapore roots which every Chinese company says they are. But they are founded and invested by Chinese and the interface is how’s as a slightly off and unintuitive layout.
